## Why this unit matters

Replace hard-coded addresses with service identities. Learn the registry lifecycle, why stale entries exist and how Eureka and Consul address the problem.

The same shop remains the anchor: Product owns catalogue information, User owns customer information, and Order coordinates checkout. Read each chapter in order to see which new requirement motivates the next design decision.

2. **[Netflix Eureka: Fundamentals](eureka-getting-started.qmd)**

## Learning objective

After this unit, describe the dependency or operational problem **before** naming a framework; draw the relevant call/event path; state the failure mode and trade-off; and explain how the concept applies to a small TypeScript or NestJS service.

## Mathematical Abstraction

Discovery maps a logical service to a changing set of instances.

$$
D_t(s)=\{i_1,i_2,\ldots,i_n\}
$$

$D_t(s)$ is the set known at time $t$ for service $s$. It can differ from the actual healthy set because of cache and lease delay.
